entities.name: Jalal Al-Din Taheri

entities.summary: Seyyed Jalaleddin Taheri Esfahani was an Iranian scholar, theologian and Islamic philosopher. He was a critic of Islamic extremism and was the representative of the Supreme Leader of Iran.
